turns.q: What do beginners usually say about it in reviews?
turns.replyTail: Yonder® Water Bottle is about 50% lighter than an equivalent Rambler® Bottle. - Its cap is 100% leakproof, and the bottle is dishwasher safe. - It is not insulated, so it won’t keep drinks cold or hot, and it may develop condensation. - It works best with cold drinks and should not be used with hot or carbonated beverages. - Scratches and some colour fading can occur with normal wear. So, it seems best suited to beginners who prioritise a lightweight, easy-care bottle over temperature retention.

turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail: tual Outfitter: For your first use, here’s the simple routine: - Fill the Yonder® Water Bottle with a cold drink. - Secure the Yonder™ Cap fully; it is 100% leakproof. - Avoid hot or carbonated beverages, food, and perishables. - Remember that it is not insulated, so condensation may occur. - When cleaning it, place the bottle and cap in the dishwasher; put the cap on the top rack and the gasket in the utensils basket. Hand washing is also suitable. The bottle is not recommended for freezer use.
